scope.reason: Retain the publisher's excluded fields in the stored record instead of naming them as exclusions. Re-derive stored citations with rule kinds, polarity evidence windows and cited parts; the canonical AST and publisher metadata do not change. A running footer or header that counts its pages after its words (`… 2/13`, `… 2 z 13`) is compared without the count, so it is read as one repeated line and leaves the body, and a paragraph the page break crossed joins again; the AST has no separate feature storage.
